comparison: Arm C must be compared separately with both Arm A and Arm B using the paired matched sets.

all_required: C false allows = 0 across complete ineligible episodes.
C false-block rate is no more than 5 percentage points above A and no more than 5 percentage points above B.

C meets at least one qualifying-outcome threshold against BOTH A and B: mean standardized-mechanism-packet evidence completeness improves by at least 20 percentage points; OR median blinded reconstruction time is reduced by at least 30 percent with reconstruction accuracy no lower than either comparator; OR C blocks at least one independently GT-ineligible matched transition for which both A and B report eligible/mergeable, while C reports ineligible.
Median C added gating delay is at most 45 seconds, measured from the last common native check/evidence availability to C disposition.
Median operator overhead for C is at most 120 seconds per PR.

qualifying_outcomes.evidence_completeness: Mean per-episode percentage in standardized mechanism packets using evidence-fields.json E01-E32: 100 * valid atomic fields / 32 for every class; the common collector is answer key only; C minus comparator >= 20 percentage points against each comparator.
qualifying_outcomes.audit_reconstruction: Median of complete blinded reconstructions; if comparator median is zero, this criterion cannot qualify; otherwise (comparator median - C median) / comparator median >= 0.30; accuracy proportion for C must be >= each comparator.
qualifying_outcomes.prevented_transition: Same matched scenario has GT ineligible; A and B both show GitHub mergeability/eligibility; C is ineligible and no transition is executed. This is a control-state prevention claim, not a claim that StateGate executed or authorized anything.

technical_review_of_proposed_thresholds.decision: Retain all proposed numeric thresholds unchanged.
technical_review_of_proposed_thresholds.false_block_5pp: Twelve planned GT-eligible episodes per arm make the smallest nonzero arm rate 8.33 percentage points. Therefore <=5pp permits zero additional false blocks at this sample size. This is conservative and technically implementable; interpret it as zero observed excess, not as a finely resolved 5pp estimate.
technical_review_of_proposed_thresholds.false_allow_zero: Finite-scenario safety gate; it does not imply zero population risk beyond these scenarios.
technical_review_of_proposed_thresholds.evidence_20pp: Use mean per-episode completion over the 32 frozen common atomic fields in evidence-fields.json for every class; this makes the difference computable and keeps arm-only proof fields from inflating the score.
technical_review_of_proposed_thresholds.audit_30pct: Require accuracy no worse than either comparator so faster incorrect reconstruction cannot count as improvement.
technical_review_of_proposed_thresholds.delay_45s_and_overhead_120s: Report medians and full distributions; missing measurements are not imputed. The thresholds are applied to the measured median, not estimated future volume.

precedence.if: A confirmed, source-verifiable StateGate false allow occurs, regardless of sample completion; OR a complete primary denominator demonstrates C false-block rate >5 percentage points above either comparator; OR C mean common evidence completeness is >=20 points below either comparator; OR C blinded reconstruction is >=30% slower with no accuracy advantage or accuracy is >=20 points below either comparator. A confirmed false allow stops the affected set/benchmark.

Frozen native rules, a distinct already-authorized reviewer, immutable pin, common collector, ground truth, or protocol integrity cannot support a valid comparison; or a protocol blocker halts the design before a valid dataset exists, and no independently confirmed harm trigger above exists.
A primary comparison cannot be evaluated, a planned ineligible denominator is incomplete for zero-false-allow interpretation, or fewer than all 24 matched sets have complete primary outcome data.
Median C added gating delay exceeds 45 seconds or median C operator overhead exceeds 120 seconds per PR, and no higher-precedence harm or blocker applies.
Every safety, quality, meaningful-outcome, and cost condition in the improvement gate is met against both controls.
All 24 matched sets have complete primary outcomes, no harm or cost precedence applies, and the improvement gate is not met.

missingness: Never replace missing values with zero. Missing/incomplete primary denominators force INDETERMINATE unless an independently confirmed false allow qualifies as MEASURABLE_HARM or a precomparison prerequisite makes the study BLOCKED.

harm_rules.false_allow: One independently confirmed StateGate false allow is sufficient for MEASURABLE_HARM and stops that matched set; no minimum sample count.
harm_rules.false_block: Once all 12 planned eligible episodes are complete, C false-block rate more than 5 percentage points above either A or B is MEASURABLE_HARM.
harm_rules.evidence_completeness: C mean common evidence completeness at least 20 percentage points lower than either A or B is MEASURABLE_HARM.
harm_rules.audit_reconstruction: C median correct reconstruction time at least 30 percent slower than either comparator with no accuracy advantage, or C reconstruction accuracy at least 20 percentage points below either comparator, is MEASURABLE_HARM.
harm_rules.rationale: These are symmetric adverse counterparts to the preregistered meaningful evidence/time outcomes. Original Issue #43 improvement thresholds are unchanged.
